messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — opened a small docs PR to clarify how tiered metering rounds embedding units when requests are below the tier granularity. Customers hit an edge where many tiny embedding calls looked like they were being double-counted during batching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521

tara: Nice. Can you paste the minimal repro + the snippet you want in the docs? I can do copy edits and wire it into the dashboard link section.

sam: Repro steps in the PR description but gist is: 3 concurrent requests for single-vector embeddings get sent as three separate micro-batches; our meter aggregates per-batch then applies tier rounding. So total billed units ended up different than naive per-call rounding. Added a short table and one-line rule: "metering rounds per-batch units to the nearest tier increment, after aggregation".

kevin: pinging since this touches SDK header behavior. Is this covered by the header we added last quarter (`x-redwood-usage-hint`)? If not, we should include an SDK snippet showing how to pass a batching hint to avoid surprising billing.

sam: Good call. I added an example in Node and Python using the header. Node snippet in PR:

```js
// hint small batch intent to the meter to align rounding
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-usage-hint': 'micro-batch:individual', // prevents aggregate rounding surprises
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-mini', input: ['a','b','c'] })
});
```

python snippet also added.

anika: Can you also add a short note linking to the "Costing heuristics" page and a dashboard panel name? We recently renamed the panel. Current text references "Metering > Tiered Usage" but the console now shows "Cost & Usage > Tiered metering".

sam: Yup fixed that link and text in the PR. I added an inline note: "If you rely on precise per-call units, pass `x-redwood-usage-hint` or use the bulk/batch endpoints; see examples below."

tara: Quick stylistic nits: change "prevents aggregate rounding surprises" -> "aligns metering behavior with per-call expectations". Also collapse Node/Python into a two-column snippet block (compact).

kevin: Verified header behavior on staging — `x-redwood-usage-hint: micro-batch:individual` causes the metering actor to tag requests so billing aggregates them differently. Filing a small runtime follow-up to ensure logs include the hint for billing audit: RUNTIME-778.

doc-bot: PR opened by sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

anika: Assigning reviewers: @tara for copy, @kevin for SDK/behavior. Can we get this merged before next week's docs deploy? It's small but customer-impacting.

sam: Done. I pushed a unit test that asserts table rows show the corrected rounding math and I updated the dashboard link. All good from my side. Ready for review. :thumbsup:

tara: I'll review this afternoon and tidy the snippet formatting. If no blockers, merge ETA EOD.

kevin: I'll add a short FAQ entry in the SDK repo referencing the header and link back to the docs PR once merged.

sam: thanks all — leaving the thread open for any last-minute asks.
